differences.a_observable: The 'Revenue Analytics' tile at the top of the frame is out of focus and blurry.
differences.b_observable: The 'Revenue Analytics' tile at the top of the frame is sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and set the focus distance to target the main blue tile.

differences.a_observable: The border of the blue 'Juspay hyperswitch' tile has a brushed metallic texture with anisotropic reflections.
differences.b_observable: The border of the blue tile is a flat, matte grey material without metallic reflections or texture.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal material with appropriate roughness and metallic maps to the tile border.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame have nearly the same brightness as the center, lacking a vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette post-process effect or adjust the camera's physical vignette settings.

json.highest_impact_fix: Apply a brushed metallic material to the borders of the tiles to match the premium look of the reference.
